page.content:
Stratford actor and playwright of Hamlet, Macbeth, and the sonnets.

How William Shakespeare connects

  • Topic: Shakespeare — William Shakespeare is the playwright at the center of this subject.
  • Work: Hamlet — William Shakespeare wrote Hamlet.
  • Work: Macbeth — William Shakespeare wrote Macbeth.
  • Work: Romeo and Juliet — William Shakespeare wrote Romeo and Juliet.
  • Location: Stratford-upon-Avon — Shakespeare was born, married, and buried in Stratford-upon-Avon.
  • Faction: Lord Chamberlain's Men — Shakespeare wrote for and held shares in the Lord Chamberlain's Men.
  • Work: The Tempest — William Shakespeare wrote The Tempest.
  • Work: King Lear — William Shakespeare wrote King Lear.
  • Work: Othello — William Shakespeare wrote Othello.
  • Work: First Folio — The First Folio collects Shakespeare's plays after his death.
  • Work: A Midsummer Night's Dream — William Shakespeare wrote A Midsummer Night's Dream.
  • Work: Henry V — William Shakespeare wrote Henry V.
  • Character: Anne Hathaway — Anne Hathaway was William Shakespeare's wife.
  • Work: Shakespeare's Sonnets — William Shakespeare wrote the 1609 sonnet sequence.
  • Faction: King's Men — Shakespeare remained a King's Man after the royal patent.

What is William Shakespeare?

William Shakespeare was the Warwickshire-born actor-shareholder who wrote for the Lord Chamberlain's Men and, later, the King's Men: Hamlet, Macbeth, Romeo and Juliet, The Tempest, the histories, and a book of sonnets.

Key threads lead to Shakespeare, Hamlet, Macbeth, Romeo and Juliet, Stratford-upon-Avon and Lord Chamberlain's Men.
